workout.text: do tryouts then after show the street kids all the dribbling move learned after the game and practicing and race them for fun whoever loses has to do 10 laps

chunks.text: Day four. You voted tryout... and the top comment said: do the tryout, then teach the street kids every move I learn, and race them. Loser runs ten laps.
Ten laps? Nah. I'm doing ten times that.
Six a.m. Sunday league tryout. Twenty-two players. Two spots. Coach didn't even look at me.
First touch... clean. Then a defender twice my size sent me flying. But I got up. Every single time.
Minute seventy. I cut inside... step-over... and slipped it through for the winner!
Coach walked over. Said one word. Saturday. That's the final cut.
So I went straight to the street pitch. Showed the kids the step-over. The cut inside. The roulette.
Then we raced. Three times. I won two... lost one.
Loser runs ten laps... so I ran a hundred. Then a hundred step-overs. Each foot. Because Saturday... I'm not getting cut.
Card check. Dribbling: fourteen to twenty-five. Physical: fifteen to twenty-one. Everything went up. Overall... twenty-one!

chunks.sub: Train with the squad all week
chunks.text: Saturday is the final cut. Option A: I train with the team all week.

chunks.title: SECRET COACH
chunks.sub: A former pro trains me in secret
chunks.text: Option B: I find a former pro to train me in secret.
Comment A or B. That's Day five.
